metadata.title: Monochrome Celebrity Portrait with Bold Sans-Serif Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome close-up portrait featuring a subject in aviator sunglasses with large, clean sans-serif text anchored at the bottom.
triggerTerms: high-contrast black and white album cover
excludeWhen: delicate or serif typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast black-and-white headshot of a man wearing metallic aviator sunglasses. The lighting emphasizes skin texture and facial contours. Large, white, geometric sans-serif typography is layered over the lower chest area, creating a strong horizontal anchor.
coreVisualRelationships: The reflection in the sunglasses adds depth to the flat monochrome plane
The horizontal bar of the aviators echoes the horizontal alignment of the text
High-key background highlights contrast against the dark clothing and hair
Text scale creates a foreground layer that pushes the subject into the mid-ground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, head and shoulders, slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white bold text across the bottom third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright forehead down to the reflective lenses, then following the jawline to the bold text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key, blown-out background on the left and right sides of the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays in skin and clothing
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in shadows and hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the typography and background highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the subject and the bright background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to create a solid block of text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast: Heavy bold display text paired with light-weight geometric numerals.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, authoritative grotesque look required for the main name.
Matches the geometric circularity of the secondary numeric text.
Alternative for a more industrial, dense typographic feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white close-up portrait of a man with short hair wearing metallic aviator sunglasses, looking slightly away from the camera. Use a bright, overexposed background to create a halo effect around the head. Ensure the lower chest area is dark to provide contrast for future text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, bold, white uppercase sans-serif text across the bottom of the image. Use tight kerning. In the bottom right corner, add secondary numeric text in a lighter weight geometric font.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text bold and uppercase?
Is the text positioned at the bottom of the frame?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the secondary numeric text

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the sunglasses and facial texture

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white highlights in the background
Ensure text does not obscure the subject's mouth
Verify the '3.0' or secondary text is thinner than the main name
Confirm the aviator bridge is clearly defined
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast BW Headshot + Aviators + Bottom-aligned Bold Sans-Serif Overlay
